conflicts.permit: As is true of most Web sites, we automatically gather information about your computer and device such as your IP address, browser type, referring/exit pages, and operating system.
conflicts.prohibit: We do not request, collect, or access your location information.
conflicts.situation: A user visits the website, where their IP address (which reveals geographic location information) is automatically gathered.
conflicts.reason: The policy flatly denies collecting or accessing location information without qualifying whether IP-based location data is excluded or exempt.
